books.title: The Secret History
books.author: Donna Tartt
books.blurb: A group of classics students at a New England college get away with murder, then slowly come apart.

books.title: Piranesi
books.author: Susanna Clarke
books.blurb: A man lives alone in a vast, flooding House of endless halls and statues, and starts to question what he remembers.

books.title: Jonathan Strange & Mr Norrell
books.author: Susanna Clarke
books.blurb: Two magicians bring magic back to England, and find they do not agree on what it should be used for.

books.title: Ninth House
books.author: Leigh Bardugo
books.blurb: A Yale freshman with a dark gift is recruited to police the secret societies that practice real magic.
books.notes: Might come back to it later.

books.title: The Goldfinch
books.author: Donna Tartt
books.blurb: A boy survives an accident that kills his mother and steals a painting that shapes the rest of his life.

books.title: Circe
books.author: Madeline Miller
books.blurb: A minor goddess is exiled to a deserted island and slowly becomes someone the gods have to reckon with.

profile.bio: Mostly dark academia and fantasy. Always slightly behind on my shelf.
